ModMetaData.name: Weazel Mode - Chinese (Traditional & Simplified)
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) and Simplified Chinese (简体中文) translation for Weazel Mode by WhereWolf.
Translates the race, faction, items, apparel, weapons, buildings, research, health conditions, backstories and the scenario. Translated from the mod's English text; terms follow the vanilla Chinese translations. The Simplified Chinese version is converted from the Traditional Chinese one.
Load after Weazel Mode. Safe to add to or remove from an existing save. A few messages compiled into the original mod's DLL stay in Korean.
